0.name: Rice Blast (Magnaporthe oryzae)
0.icarRecommendation: Spray Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6 g/L or Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5 mL/L. Avoid excessive nitrogenous fertilizer application during active tillering.

1.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight (Xanthomonas oryzae)
1.icarRecommendation: Spray Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L + Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L. Drain field and apply 25% extra Potash (MOP) to induce systemic resistance.

2.name: Brown Spot (Bipolaris oryzae)
2.icarRecommendation: Foliar spray of Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2 g/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 mL/L. Ensure balanced potassium and zinc micronutrient fertilization.

3.name: Healthy Rice Foliage
3.icarRecommendation: Canopy is vigorous and healthy. Maintain intermittent wetting and drying (AWD) water management and baseline NPK schedule.

4.name: Cotton Leaf Curl Virus (CLCuV)
4.icarRecommendation: Manage whitefly vector by installing yellow sticky traps (10/acre) and foliar spray of Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1 g/L or Flonicamid 50% WG @ 0.3 g/L.

5.name: Bacterial Blight (Xanthomonas malvacearum)
5.icarRecommendation: Spray Copper Hydroxide 77% WP @ 2 g/L or Streptocycline @ 100 ppm. Collect and burn infected plant debris post-harvest.

6.name: Healthy Cotton Foliage
6.icarRecommendation: No foliar viral or bacterial symptoms detected. Continue regular scouting for bollworm and sucking pests.

7.name: Tomato Early Blight (Alternaria solani)
7.icarRecommendation: Spray Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1 mL/L or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2 g/L. Prune lower diseased foliage to enhance airflow.

8.name: Tomato Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans)
8.icarRecommendation: Immediate preventative spray of Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1 g/L. Avoid overhead furrow splashing.

9.name: Healthy Tomato Foliage
9.icarRecommendation: Foliage shows vibrant chlorophyll levels without concentric lesions. Maintain drip irrigation and prophylactic bio-fungicide sprays.
